title: Milo the Monkey's Slow Day
description: A jungle story about a energetic monkey who discovers that helping others is better than winning a race.

scenes.narration: Milo the monkey loved to move fast, swinging from vine to vine through the lush green jungle canopy.
scenes.visual: playful little brown monkey swinging enthusiastically through bright green jungle leaves

scenes.narration: Today was the big jungle swing, and Milo wanted to be the very first to reach the grand banana tree.
scenes.visual: cute monkey sitting on a high branch looking determinedly toward the distant horizon

scenes.narration: As he leaped past a thick branch, he heard a small squeak. A tiny caterpillar was stuck under a twig.
scenes.visual: tiny green caterpillar pinned under a small brown twig on a thick tree branch

scenes.narration: Milo slowed down. If he stopped to help, he would lose his lead, but he could not leave a friend behind.
scenes.visual: monkey pausing mid swing and looking down thoughtfully at the tiny caterpillar

scenes.narration: Carefully, Milo lifted the heavy twig with his tail, letting the happy little caterpillar crawl safely away.
scenes.visual: monkey gently lifting a small twig off a smiling green caterpillar with his tail

scenes.narration: Even though the other monkeys finished first, they all cheered for Milo when they heard about his kindness.
scenes.visual: group of friendly jungle animals gathered around a happy monkey high in the trees

scenes.narration: Being kind is the greatest victory of all. Sweet dreams, and follow along for more cozy stories tonight.
scenes.visual: cute little monkey curled up asleep on a soft hammock woven from green leaves
